Question: Assalamu Allaikaum (1) Is it is allowed in any circumstance for a Muslim girl to marry a Hindu boy. If the girl is very obedient and done nothing bad in her past for her parents and except talking, (2) she is not more engaged with that boy. But she had made committment.. What parents can do? (3) of course She will marry with the body who will be selected by their parents, then what about the only request made by so obedient girl from her parents in whole life? Answer ID: 12322 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 825/689=D/1430) (1) It is impermissible. (2) Even talking to her is also prohibited and unlawful. (3) The girl should stay loyal and obedient to parents and should follow the Shariah. She should deliberate that the only request is how much dangerous for her iman . The girl should be made not to drink this poison which, it will destroy her religion and faith. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
